title: 第三章 枫叶红第四章 燕子洞
content_zh:
那个被唤作狗蛋的小孩缓缓爬来，只是忽然闻着驰道上的血味，立刻如狼崽子似的，警惕得躲在草丛里。看来又要小心观察一会儿了。
大小眼显然也知道他的性子，微微一笑，也不见怪，招呼其他人道，
“咱们先入山吧。”
于是其他六个少年也纷纷起身，擦着汗，陆续跟那领队的大小眼入林，断后的眯眼剑客也不再望向两人，按着刀把，转身从路口走开。
蒹葭一时还盯着白马的尸身发呆。而小侯爷吕岳望着那行人转身离去，逐个隐入林中的背影，忽然心中一凛，他立刻回过神来，赶紧抢过少女手中的石匣，咬着牙冲过去，手捧那剑匣一口气冲到山口，高声叫道，
“家祖沈槐！北辰剑宗弟子！拜在九阴山下修行！得传飞剑一口！证物在此！
弟子吕岳，并表妹蒹葭！遭仇人追杀，愿拜入仙山求道！
还请仙长垂怜！收我等于门下！”
说罢他手捧石匣，一个滑跪，咚咚咚连磕三个响头。
总算他赌对了，只要‘下马’，眯眯眼倒也没再出剑斩他。只是对方也不搭理他，兀自往山门里去。
一时间，吕岳的心如坠深渊，沉入谷底。只觉得这个瞬间，仿佛什么看不见，摸不着的东西，从指尖流过，而且再也没机会握住了……
忽然，吕岳只觉手中一轻，竟是手中石匣飞空而起。抬眼看时，原来是那大小眼的，又搂着剑，拖着步子，街溜子似晃荡回来，把石匣收入袖中，
“来吧。”
吕岳大喜，扭头道，
“蒹葭！快来拜见……”
“诶诶，只收一个。”
吕岳一愣，扭头看去，只见那大小眼懒懒散散的靠在树干上，依旧望着那边草窠里，幼狼似谨慎的小子，随口朝他道，
“人招满啦，你自带一口剑，顶多再收你一个。”
“什么……”
吕岳一时楞住了。

蒹葭倒是反应过来了，小心得牵着马车，来到山口，把缰绳递过去，
“小侯爷，既如此，你入山去吧。你天赋道骨，有侯爷给你准备的许多天材地宝，成就剑仙绝非难事。
咱们就此拜别，俺到锦都城去，与娘亲和姨娘会合，等你成了仙，得了道，总有咱们相会之日的……”
吕岳皱眉，忽然想到了什么，爬起来从马车里捧出个箱子，送到大小眼剑客面前，
“这位师兄，此处有辟兵钱五十枚，鱼尾金三十两，锻骨筑基丹，易筋融血丸，通玄还灵丹，灵芝返命丸，雪莲还魂丹，皆是精炼六转以上的灵丹，还请您行个方便……”
大小眼却看也不看，只用小眼斜他，
“呵。你当上山享福呢，还带个丫鬟伺候啊。”
这吕岳好歹也是个小侯爷，更是个年轻人，从来不拉下面子低声下气求人，哪里受得几次三番这么激，更别说对方这话还轻贱了蒹葭，一时血涌上头，正欲发作，却见对方那只大眼，竟还一直盯着另一侧。
于是吕岳也扭过头，顺着对方的视线望去。此时其他人皆已入了山，这视线自然是落在最后的乞丐小子身上。
这狗蛋，依旧狗似得伏在草窠里，还不曾入得林中，而大小眼分明就是来等他的。显然，这是个体怀灵根，身有道缘之子。
自小在侯府见多了世面，吕岳也是心思一动，挺起腰杆，双拳一抱，朝那小子一指，
“久闻北辰剑宗大名，门内弟子若争仙缘，皆以真剑比斗，勿论生死！
光霞山既是剑宗外山，想来也依此理行事吧！
那在下若赢了那小子，是不是可以夺他的仙缘，拜入山中修行！”
大小眼把两只眼转过来，盯着瞅了瞅他，一点头，
“是。”
见对方答得如此干脆，吕岳也点点头，抱拳道，
content_en:
The child who was called Goudan crawled over slowly, but suddenly smelled the smell of blood on the road and immediately hid in the grass like a wolf cub. It seems that we need to watch carefully for a while again.
Big Eyes obviously also knew his temperament. He smiled slightly, not surprised, and greeted the others,
"Let's go into the mountain first."
So the other six teenagers also stood up, wiped their sweat, and followed the leader into the forest one after another. The squinting swordsman behind them stopped looking at the two of them, pressed the handle of his sword, turned and walked away from the intersection.
Jian Jia was still staring at Baima's body in a daze. The young Marquis Lu Yue watched the pedestrians turning away and disappearing into the forest one by one. Suddenly, his heart froze. He immediately came back to his senses and quickly grabbed the stone box from the girl's hand. He gritted his teeth and rushed over. He rushed to the mountain pass with the sword box in his hand and shouted loudly,
"Family ancestor Shen Huai! Disciple of Beichen Sword Sect! I worship at the foot of Jiuyin Mountain to practice! I have to pass on the Flying Sword! The evidence is here!
Disciple Lu Yue, and cousin Jian Jia! Being chased by the enemy, I am willing to worship in the fairy mountain to seek enlightenment!
Please have mercy on me! Accept me as your disciple! "
After saying that, he held the stone box in his hand, knelt down and kowtowed three times in a row.
Finally, he made the right bet, as long as he 'dismounted', Nian Nian did not use his sword to kill him again. But the other party ignored him and went to the mountain gate alone.
For a moment, Lu Yue's heart felt like falling into an abyss, sinking to the bottom. I just feel that at this moment, something invisible and intangible flows through my fingertips, and I will never have the chance to hold it...
Suddenly, Lu Yue felt a light touch in his hand, and the stone box in his hand flew into the air. When he looked up, it turned out to be the one with the big eyes, holding the sword again, dragging his steps, wandering back from the street, putting the stone box into his sleeve,
"Come on."
Lu Yue was overjoyed and turned around and said,
"Jianjia! Come and meet..."
"Hey, I only accept one."
Lu Yue was stunned, and turned around to look, only to see the big eyes lazily leaning against the tree trunk, still looking at the grass nest over there. The young wolf looked like a cautious boy, and casually said to him,
"We're full. You bring your own sword. I'll take you in at most."
"What..."
Lu Yue was stunned for a moment.
Jian Jia finally reacted and carefully led the carriage to the mountain pass and handed over the reins.
"Little Marquis, if that's the case, you can go into the mountains. You are gifted with Taoism, and with the many natural and earthly treasures that the Marquis has prepared for you, it is not difficult to become a swordsman.
Let's say goodbye now. I'll go to Jindu City to meet up with my mother and aunt. When you become an immortal and gain Taoism, there will always be a day when we can meet..."
Lu Yue frowned and suddenly thought of something. He got up and took out a box from the carriage and brought it to the big-eyed swordsman.
"Senior Brother, here are fifty coins for establishing soldiers, thirty taels of fish-tail gold, bone-forging foundation-building pills, Yijin-melting blood pills, Tongxuan-returning pills, Ganoderma-reviving pills, and Snow Lotus-reviving pills. They are all pills that have been refined for more than six rounds. Please make it easier..."
But he didn't even look at it with his big or small eyes. He only looked at him with his small eyes.
"Ha. You go up to the mountain to enjoy the blessings, and you bring a maid to take care of you."
After all, Lu Yue was a young prince, and he was a young man. He never lowered his dignity and begged for help. How could he be so provoked several times, not to mention that the other party had belittled Jian Jia with his words. For a moment, blood rushed to his head, and he was about to have an attack, but he saw the other party's big eyes, which were still staring at the other side.
So Lu Yue also turned his head and followed the other person's line of sight. At this time, everyone else had entered the mountain, and naturally their eyes fell on the last beggar boy.
This Goudan was still crouching in the grass nest like a dog. He had not yet entered the forest, and his big and small eyes were clearly waiting for him. Obviously, this is the son of an individual with spiritual roots and a predestined relationship.
Having seen a lot of the world in the Hou Mansion since he was a child, Lu Yue also had a thought. He straightened up his waist, clasped his fists, and pointed at the boy,
"I have heard about the famous name of Beichen Sword Sect for a long time. If the disciples in the sect compete for immortality, they will all fight with real swords, regardless of life or death!
Guangxia MountainSince you are from outside the Sword Sect, you should act accordingly if you think about it!
If I defeat that boy, can I take away his immortality and worship him in the mountains to practice? "
Big and small eyes turned around, stared at him, nodded,
"Yes. "
Seeing that the other party answered so simply, Lu Yue also nodded, cupped his fists and said,
